description: Join a plan as the person you act for. If a participant with the same name already exists, you act as them (like picking your name in the app). Returns participant_id and participant_token. Confirm the name with the user first.

name.description: The person's name as the group knows them (max 80 chars).

plan.description: Saved plan link (e.g. https://lesgooo.fun/ab12/when) or its 4-character id. Bare module links such as https://lesgooo.fun/when are local drafts: ask for a saved link, never substitute a previous plan ID.

name: join_plan
title: Join a plan
